products.name: Guest Maintenance Handoff
products.product: A focused hotel guest maintenance handoff workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent boutique hotels and small hospitality teams
products.problem: In-stay maintenance reports pass among front desk, housekeeping, engineering, and vendors while room access, guest promises, compensations, and verification are tracked separately.
products.valueProposition: Turns hotel guest maintenance handoff into a visible operating queue so every guest-impacting maintenance issue has a coordinated access plan, verified repair, and completed guest follow-up.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets hotel guest maintenance, hotel maintenance request workflow, room repair tracking, and hotel engineering handoff searches.

products.name: Lost and Found Claim Desk
products.product: A focused hotel lost and found claim tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent boutique hotels and small hospitality teams
products.problem: Found-item logs, guest descriptions, storage locations, identity checks, shipping choices, and release evidence are difficult to reconcile across shifts.
products.valueProposition: Turns hotel lost and found claim tracking into a visible operating queue so every found item and guest claim is matched, released, retained, or disposed under policy with a complete custody trail.
products.topic: hotel lost and found claim tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets hotel lost and found software, lost property claim tracker, hotel found item log, and lost and found chain of custody searches.

products.name: Group Rooming List Chaser
products.product: A focused hotel group rooming list tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent boutique hotels and small hospitality teams
products.problem: Names, room types, arrival details, accessibility notes, billing instructions, and changes arrive from group contacts in repeated spreadsheet versions near cutoff.
products.valueProposition: Turns hotel group rooming list tracking into a visible operating queue so every contracted group block reaches a validated rooming list and reconciled reservation set by the operational cutoff.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets hotel rooming list tracker, group block rooming list, rooming list cutoff, and hotel group reservation workflow searches.
